title: 第16幕疯狂的2v4第17幕现在是2v2了
content_zh:
第16幕 疯狂的2V4
12分钟的时候，第二次审判降临，这一次被抹杀的是邢辰一方的流浪剑客，只因为他被风行者给击杀了一次，最终比风行者差了区区3分而垫底抹杀。
“该死！居然不是抹杀我们这边的人！”
看到这个结果蓝蝶忍不住低声骂了一句。
成为替补的玩家都是上一轮试炼之战中失败的人，只要再输一次就必死无疑，所以他们无一例外都会在成为替补后疯狂磨练自己的技术，成效怎么样因人而异，但是绝对要比这几个新人好用得多。
每隔6分钟一次的审判实际上就是一种平衡机制，哪一队实力较弱就会抹杀掉一个扯后腿的换上一个至少可以说会玩的替补，被抹杀人员的一方实力也就得到了相应的加强。
邢辰一方本来就在场面上占据着主动，这一次12分钟的审判还抹杀了邢辰一方的流浪剑客换上了一个替补，这就更让蓝蝶他们难打了。
…………
“这样搞下去不行啊……必须要限制一下暗痕那家伙的幻影刺客了，不然的话后期就太难打了。”
从纠结的中路解脱出来之后，蓝蝶立刻意识到照这么发展下去自己的处境恐怕会很不妙，幻影刺客实在是太顺了，暗痕的技术明显是要比自家那个1300的人要高出一些的，再加上之前收到的人头钱发育速度绝对慢不了。
想到这里，蓝蝶下决心道：“遗忘法师、风行者和撼地神牛都跟我过来，我们去抓幻影刺客。消失，你们眼睛都给我放亮点，别看走了眼！”
一般来说像试炼之战这种低水平的战斗通常都不会有人买眼做视野，但是蓝蝶觉得既然对面的末日使者玩的不错，那么他买眼保人的几率就很大，所以还是小心点吃个诡计之雾之后再上为妙。
蓝蝶的判断没有错，上路正在打钱的幻影刺客周围的确插了保护眼，但是却不是邢辰插的，而是冰女江欣颖。
跟着邢辰一路领工资，冰女的钱几乎全部都买了眼，诡计之雾也是CD一到就买，用不用暂且不论，先存着免得浪费CD。
蓝蝶的宙斯带着自己的小弟们借着诡计之雾的掩护，千里奔袭天灾野区准备抓幻影刺客，却不想刚刚绕进上路野区身上灰色的诡计之雾效果就消失不见了，紧接着，冰女娇弱的身影出现在几人的视线里。
“倒霉！居然被发现了！”
蓝蝶咬牙切齿的低吼了一声，这里被撞破就意味着他们的目标——幻影刺客有了充足的时间逃走。
一想到幻影刺客没了，蓝蝶就是一阵的咬牙切齿，在队伍频道中泄愤般的命令道：“把这个家伙给我留下！”
己方4个打对面1个，蓝蝶众人气势高涨，轰然应诺。
已经换了人的遗忘法师首先对冰女使用了衰老，让冰女进入到了虚无状态，虽然这种状态下的英雄是无法被物理攻击的，但是其移动速度会降低50%，而且会提升50%的魔法伤害效果！

紧接着，遗忘法师的幽冥轰爆，宙斯的雷击，风行者的强力击，撼地神牛的沟壑齐齐砸向了可怜的冰女MM。
毫无疑问的秒杀！
秒杀了对方的一个英雄这原本应该是件值得高兴的事情，但是蓝蝶却突然想到了一个问题——冰女这种脆皮的英雄难道能一个人打野么？尤其是使用冰女的玩家还是一个新人！
想到这里，蓝蝶不禁再次怒吼起来：“该死的，你们搞什么！？末日使者一定就在旁边，你们却为了一个冰女把技能全扔了！”
蓝蝶话音刚落，末日使者便从前方不远处的树林里钻了出来。
“不是你说把她留下的么？”风行者奇怪的反问，完全不明白这个资深者到底为什么生气。
“叫你们留人可没让你们把技能放干净啊！就那么一个冰女我一人就足够了，你们把技能全扔了剩下的末日使者怎么办！？”
“啊？还有这回事？我就玩过两次Dota，怎么会知道到底多少技能能打死一个人啊！”风行者不满的抱怨起来，“再说了，就算还有末日使者又怎么了，难道咱们4个还怕他一个？”
蓝蝶也明白跟这些对Dota没什么概念的菜鸟多说只是白费力气罢了，扭头一想风行者说的也有道理，就算技能交多了他们4个难道还怕末日一个？大不了让末日使者再多活过几秒罢了。于是强忍着怒火命令道：
“好吧，其他的我就不管了，现在给我把那个末日使者杀了！”
“这个简单，4打1还能怕了他么？”
顿时，所有人的目光都集中到了邢辰的末日使者身上。
…………
刚刚发现有敌人突然从自己的背后窜出来的时候邢辰已经意识到了不妙，他知道这种状况下自己慌不择路的逃跑肯定不是最佳选择，只有冷静的分析才能够找出最好的应对之策。
趁着蓝蝶几人围殴冰女的时候，邢辰迅速查看了一下对方几人的装备：除了蓝蝶装备还算说得过去之外，其他几人都是只有一双鞋外加一两个挂件、护腕、树枝之类的小件装备，非常的寒酸。
看到这里，邢辰的脑中立刻对局面有了一个大致的判断：
第1，在敌我人数上，敌人有4个，而己方算上暗痕的幻影刺客也只有两个，暗影萨满这个菜鸟的传送支援显然指望不上，而替补的流浪剑客装备栏里则压根就没有传送卷轴；
第2，在装备上，此时发育异常顺利的幻影刺客装备栏中已经有了假腿、压制之刃、狂战斧和一个有着7格能量的大魔棒；邢辰的末日使者也做出了秘法鞋、灵魂之戒、压制之刃、8格能量的大魔棒以及价值1600块钱的暗影护符。而敌人则基本什么都没有；
第3，在技术上，近卫方除了蓝蝶和替补的遗忘法师勉强还算可以之外，其他人……完全不用评论。
第4，在状态上，虽然对方4人血量都是全满，可主要技能几乎全部都在CD中，而且撼地神牛的魔法值也不多了，自己的末日使者刚刚吃下了一个四级萨特拥有抽魔技能，足够把撼地神牛抽的除了加强图腾什么也放不出来！

分析到这里，邢辰立刻有了一个疯狂的计划——在被抓死一人，附近只有幻影刺客这么一个脆皮后期可以帮忙，其余两个队友显然指望不上的情况下，面对着对面高爆发、状态全满的4人Gank，他想到的不是该怎么逃跑，而是要反杀！而且还要将他们4个全部留下！
只要能够抓住敌人技能CD的空间就一定有获胜的机会！
…………
撼地神牛：在贫瘠之地，传说有群牛头人贤者，世代在此播种收割。他们的思想与脚下的这片褐土地结合在一起。他们的精神力能引导土壤的流向。这些战士仅凭一时兴起就能制造出深深的沟壑，因此让人感到畏惧。他们的力量是如此强大，以至于他们每次使用魔法都会对大地造成强烈的震动。可悲的是这些贤者们却神秘地从这个大陆上消失了。当世界之树被威胁之时，它的仆从们寻找到了这个强大的种族，但此时这个种族仅剩下一个族人。Ragior_Stonehoof，这个技艺娴熟的年轻牛头人，寻求着战斗，以创造新的传奇。
沟壑：在地表形成1300码的巨大的沟壑，8秒内不能通行，并造成伤害和晕眩。等级4－造成275点伤害，
加强图腾：在撼地神牛背上的图腾中注入力量，使撼地神牛的下一次攻击能造成额外的伤害。等级4－增加300%的基础攻击力。
余震：每当撼地神牛施放技能时，都会使周围300范围内的地面震动，造成额外的伤害并晕眩。等级4－造成125点的额外伤害，
终极技能回音击：撼地神牛重击地面发出震波，对周围的敌方单位造成伤害，震波相互弹射会造成更大伤害！等级3－造成340点的伤害，震波每次弹射造成额外的70点的伤害。神杖升级：震波会对敌方英雄弹射两次。
content_en:
Act 16 Crazy 2V4
At 12 minutes, the second trial came. This time, the wandering swordsman from Xing Chen's side was eliminated. Just because he was killed once by Windrunner, he was finally eliminated at the bottom, just 3 points behind Windrunner.
"Damn it! You didn't kill the people on our side!"
Seeing this result, Landie couldn't help but cursed in a low voice.
The players who become substitutes are all those who failed in the previous round of trial battles. If they lose again, they will definitely die. Therefore, without exception, they will hone their skills like crazy after becoming substitutes. The results vary from person to person, but they are definitely much easier to use than these newcomers.
The trial every 6 minutes is actually a balancing mechanism. Whichever team is weaker will eliminate a laggard and replace it with a substitute who can at least be said to be good at playing. The strength of the eliminated team will be correspondingly strengthened.
Xing Chen's side had already taken the initiative in the scene, but this time the 12-minute trial also eliminated Xing Chen's wandering swordsman and replaced him with a substitute, which made it even more difficult for Lan Die and the others to fight.
…………
"We can't go on like this... We have to restrict the Phantom Assassin from Dark Mark, otherwise it will be too difficult to fight in the later stage."
After being freed from the tangled middle lane, Lan Die immediately realized that his situation might be very bad if it continued like this. The Phantom Assassin was too smooth, and Dark Mark's skills were obviously higher than that of his 1300 player. In addition, the head money he received before would definitely not slow down his development speed.
Thinking of this, Lan Die made up his mind and said: "Forgotten Mage, Windrunner and Earth-shaking Divine Ox all come with me. Let's catch the Phantom Assassin. Disappear. Please shine a bright light on your eyes for me. Don't let your eyes wander!"
Generally speaking, in low-level battles like the trial battle, no one would buy wards for vision. However, Lan Die felt that since the opponent's Doombringer was playing well, there was a high chance that he would buy wards to protect people, so it was better to be careful before taking the fog of trickery.
Landie's judgment was correct. The phantom assassin who was collecting money on the road was indeed surrounded by protective eyes, but it was not placed by Xing Chen, but by the ice girl Jiang Xinying.
Following Xing Chen all the way to collect wages, I spent almost all of Ice Girl's money to buy Eyes. I also bought the Mist of Conspiracy as soon as the CD arrived. I didn't care whether I would use it or not. I saved it first to avoid wasting the CD.
Blue Butterfly's Zeus and his younger brothers took advantage of the cover of the fog of trickery and rushed thousands of miles into the natural disaster jungle area to catch the phantom assassin. However, they didn't expect that the effect of the gray fog of trickery disappeared just as they entered the upper jungle zone. Then, the delicate figure of the ice girl appeared in the sight of several people.
"Unlucky! We were discovered!"
Landie gritted his teeth and roared. Being hit here meant that their target, the Phantom Assassin, had enough time to escape.
Thinking of the Phantom Assassin being gone, Lan Die gritted his teeth and ordered in the team channel to vent his anger: "Leave this guy alone!"
Four of them fought against one of the other side. Everyone in Landie was full of energy and agreed with a loud voice.
The Forgotten Mage who has changed people first used Aging on the Ice Girl, causing the Ice Girl to enter a state of nothingness. Although the hero in this state cannot be physically attacked, its movement speed will be reduced by 50%, and the magic damage effect will be increased by 50%!
Immediately afterwards, the Forgotten Mage's Nether Explosion, Zeus's Lightning Strike, Windrunner's Powerful Strike, and the Earth-shaking Divine Bull's ravine all hit the poor Ice Girl.
Undoubtedly an instant kill!
Killing an opponent's hero instantly should have been a joyful thing, but Lan Die suddenly thought of a question - can a fragile hero like Ice Girl be able to go jungle alone? Especially the player who uses Ice Girl is still a newbie!
Thinking of this, Landie couldn't help roaring again:"Damn it, what are you doing!? The Doombringer must be nearby, but you threw away all your skills for an ice girl!"
As soon as Lan Die finished speaking, the Doomsday Messenger emerged from the woods not far ahead.
"Didn't you tell her to keep her?" Windrunner asked strangely, not understanding why the senior was angry at all.
"I asked you to retain people but I didn't ask you to use all your skills! Just one Ice Girl is enough for me. If you throw away all your skills, what will happen to the remaining Doombringers!?"
"Ah? Is there such a thing? I've only played Dota twice, how do I know how many skills can kill a person!" Windrunner complained dissatisfiedly, "Besides, what if there is the Bringer of Doom? Are the four of us still afraid of him?"
Landie also understood that talking to these newbies who had no idea about Dota was just a waste of effort. He turned around and thought about what Windrunner said. It made sense. Even if he had four more skills, could he still be afraid of the end of one of them? The worst that could happen would be to let the doomsday messenger survive for a few more seconds. So he suppressed his anger and ordered:
"Okay, I don't care about the rest. Now kill that messenger of doom!"
"This is simple. Can you still be afraid of him with 4 on 1?"
Suddenly, everyone's eyes were focused on Xing Chen's doomsday messenger.
…………
Xing Chen had just realized that something was wrong when he discovered that an enemy suddenly jumped out from behind him. He knew that running away in a panic was definitely not the best choice in this situation. Only calm analysis could find the best response.
While Lan Die and others were beating up the ice girl, Xing Chen quickly checked the equipment of the opponents: Except for Lan Die's equipment, which was pretty good, the others only had a pair of shoes and one or two pendants, wrist guards, branches and other small equipment, which were very shabby.
Seeing this, Xing Chen immediately made a rough judgment on the situation in his mind:
First, in terms of the number of enemies, there are 4 enemies, and there are only two Phantom Assassins on our side including Dark Mark. The Shadow Shaman, a rookie, obviously cannot count on teleportation support, and the substitute Wandering Swordsman does not have a teleportation scroll in the equipment column at all;
Second, in terms of equipment, the Phantom Assassin, which is developing extremely well at this time, already has prosthetic legs, a suppressing blade, a mad battle ax and a big magic wand with 7 energy bars in its equipment column; Xing Chen's Doomsday Messenger also made arcane shoes, a soul ring, a suppressing blade, a big magic wand with 8 energy bars, and a shadow amulet worth 1,600 yuan. The enemy, on the other hand, has basically nothing;
Third, technically speaking, apart from Lan Die and the substitute Forgotten Mage, the other players on the Guards side... don't need to comment at all.
Fourth, in terms of status, although the health of the four opponents is full, almost all of the main skills are in the CD, and the Earth-Shaking Divine Cow's magic value is not much. My own Doomsday Messenger has just eaten a level 4 satyr with the magic-draining skill, which is enough to draw the Earth-Shaking Divine Cow. It can't release anything except strengthening the totem!
After analyzing this, Xing Chen immediately came up with a crazy plan - after one person was caught and killed, and only the squishy Phantom Assassin could help in the late stage, and the other two teammates obviously couldn't count on him, facing the opponent's high-explosion, full-status 4-man gank, what he thought of was not how to escape, but to counterattack! And I want to keep all 4 of them!
As long as you can seize the space of the enemy's skill CD, you will definitely have a chance to win!
…………
Earth-shaking sacred cow: In the barren land, legend has it that there is a group of tauren sages who have been sowing and harvesting here for generations. Their thoughts were united with the brown earth beneath their feet. Their spiritual power can direct the flow of soil. These warriors are feared for their ability to create deep ravines on a whim. their strengthThe power is so powerful that every time they use magic, it will cause strong vibrations to the earth. Sadly, these sages mysteriously disappeared from this continent. When the World Tree was threatened, its servants found this powerful race, but at this time there was only one member of this race left. Ragior_Stonehoof, a skilled young tauren, seeks battle to create a new legend.
Gully: A huge gully of 1,300 yards is formed on the ground, which is impassable for 8 seconds and causes damage and stun. Level 4 - Causes 275 damage,
Strengthen Totem: Inject power into the totem on the back of the Earth-shaking God Bull, so that the Earth-shaking God Cow's next attack can cause additional damage. Level 4 - Increases base attack power by 300%.
Aftershock: Whenever the Earth-Shaking Bull casts a skill, it will shake the ground within 300 meters around it, causing additional damage and stunning. Level 4 - Causes 125 points of additional damage,
Ultimate skill Echo Strike: The earth-shaking sacred bull hits the ground hard to emit shock waves, causing damage to surrounding enemy units. The shock waves will bounce off each other to cause greater damage! Level 3 - Causes 340 points of damage, and each shockwave bounce causes an additional 70 points of damage. Aghanim's Scepter Upgrade: Shockwave will ricochet twice to enemy heroes.
